== Description ==

[[AJ Hatoum]] (left, light brown hair, glasses, black graphic tee, name tag, standing and smiling) and [[Logan Pietig]] (right, brown hair, black UWL hoodie, standing and smiling) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
